purpose: A Claude Code plugin that installs a layered, mechanically-enforced documentation method into a repo. README.md is the one-page method; docs/contributing.md is seam's own instance of it.
users: Anyone adopting the method into a repo, and anyone working on seam itself.
in_scope: The method, the templates, the generator and the two emitted checkers
Issue, commit and PR conventions, and the review policy
out_of_scope: Any repo's content — legal doctrines, schemas, pipelines, design systems
Domain agents: the plugin ships the agent shape and the wizard writes the repo's agents from it

docs.owns: How work on seam is done, and this table's host file
The domain labels, the three priorities, and the milestones
The start contract, the finish contract, the test-first rule, and the proportionality rule with its three sizes
The threshold table, what triggers a level, the dispatch rule, and where a session's own artifacts live
The model and effort pinned per artifact, and this repo's agent shape
What was chosen, the options rejected, and why — plus in-flight rulings and direction corrections
Nothing — dated design documents. Superseded wholesale; a design that changes is rewritten or replaced, never amended into agreement with what shipped
Nothing — implementation plans. Superseded wholesale; a plan whose shape changes is rewritten, never amended into agreement with what shipped

domains.name: wizard
domains.covers: skills/seam-docs/ — the interview, the layer classification, the templates

domains.name: checker
domains.covers: bin/generate-checker.mjs, skills/seam-checks/, the emitted checker templates

domains.name: github
domains.covers: skills/seam-github/ — issues, branches, commits, PRs, the gate

domains.name: review
domains.covers: skills/seam-review/ — the level table, the rounds, the triggers

domains.name: tests
domains.covers: tests/, evals/ — the probe rule's half and the skills' half

domains.name: docs
domains.covers: docs/ — seam's own doc layer, eating its own dog food

allow.reason: the DEFAULT NAME of the table's host file in an adopting repo, not a file here — seam's own host is docs/contributing.md, and that file's § Sources of truth explains why
a filename form: skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Every real one is cited with its directory and resolves
the filename inside an eval case directory, cited as a form. Every real one is at evals/<case>/prompt.md and resolves

open_questions: Does seam need a layer-4 PRD, given that README.md is the intent and it is public? No docs/prd row is proposed yet.
